title: Kestrel and the Static
author: Marguerite Amberdale
blurb: Mirabel Quintana, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
